question: According to the Global Peace Index 2024, what is the role of Positive Peace in the context of violent conflict and economic instability?

options.text: It measures the number of conflicts per country
It identifies structural factors that promote peace and can forecast declines in peacefulness
It calculates the percentage of GDP lost due to war

solution:
The correct answer is __**It identifies structural factors that promote peace and can forecast declines in peacefulness**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• Positive Peace refers to the attitudes, institutions, and structures that create and sustain peaceful societies, according to the Global Peace Index 2024.
 
• It is a framework that helps identify structural factors promoting peace and resilience against conflict and economic instability.
 
• The Positive Peace Index (PPI) uses eight pillars, including good governance, equitable distribution of resources, and high level
